items.title: AI Content Governance Inside a Regulated Bank - with Stefan Zima of Raiffeisen Bank International AG
items.summary: Financial institutions are moving fast on generative AI without a clear answer for who owns, and who is liable for, the content it produces and consumes. In this episode, Stefan Zima, Head of Group Regulatory Compliance and AI Compliance at Raiffeisen Bank International AG, examines how banks can build real accountability and visibility into their AI content practices before regulators or auditors force the issue. The conversation covers cross-border data governance, third-party AI risk, and where research reports, market commentary, and training materials create the most exposure. ​ Learn how leading AI brands like NVIDIA and Google Cloud work with Emerj to reach Fortune 500 AI buyers - download our media kit at: emerj.com/AD1
